profiles.sample_rule: stratified sampling with exact balance: per cell an order that interleaves its rule families (families in a seed-keyed order, each family's units in a seed-keyed order, one unit per family per round), whole units taken from the front (at least one); a fluid cell until its quota of scored positions is met; then each supporting cell to the prefix that fits its integer share of the fluid half's REALIZED positions, and the residual closed exactly by the fewest whole units (at most 3) earliest in the cells' remaining orders interleaved (build_mixed_profiles.py)
